text:
sam: FYI I bumped into a weird telemetry gap in the Node quickstart: when we use axios-retry the x-request-id vanishes on the retried request and traces don't join. short repro below.

jess: that's bad for request correlation. only axios-retry?

nate: could be the library cloning the config and losing headers, or our otel outgoing hook running before the retry wrapper re-attaches headers. seen similar with undici pools.

sam: repro (tiny):
```js
const axios = require('axios');
require('axios-retry')(axios, { retries: 1 });
await axios.post('https://svc/internal', { foo: 'bar' }, { headers: { 'x-request-id': 'r-100' } });
```
logs trimmed: 2025-06-07T10:01:00Z sampleapp DEBUG outgoing x-request-id=r-100
2025-06-07T10:01:01Z sampleapp DEBUG outgoing x-request-id=-

olivia: looks like header dropped entirely rather than redacted. our formatter masks values when empty which makes it look like a dash.
jess: mitigation ideas: 1) update our otel http hook to consult a per-request context store and re-inject allowlisted headers on every outgoing attempt, 2) change quickstart to prefer undici/keepalive, 3) add a tiny axios wrapper that clones headers into retry config.
nate: I prefer the hook approach for compatibility across retry libs and SDKs. we should maintain an allowlist (x-request-id, traceparent) and explicitly avoid Authorization.
sam: prototype: middleware that seeds AsyncLocalStorage with the incoming request id and the otel hook always injects from ALS if missing. works in local repro.

olivia: can we add a unit/e2e in sampleapp that simulates a 502 and asserts x-request-id preserved across retry? that would catch regressions. also add a short doc note about axios-retry caveats until we ship fix.
jess: one more quirk: dev logs (DEBUG) show full ids but prod logging uses redaction plugin which replaced empty strings with '-' making the symptom confusing. open an issue to clarify redaction rules in the logging plugin so we don't mask real losses.
telemetry-bot: Created issue #4521: "Node quickstart: x-request-id lost on axios-retry; add ALS reinjection + e2e; clarify redaction behavior" (assigned devex).
sam: I'll open a PR with the ALS middleware + test. nate can review the otel hook change. olivia will update quickstart docs.
